answer_1.quote: we present ACLSUM, a new multi-aspect extreme summarization dataset manually annotated and validated by domain experts.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we report standard ROUGE scores and BERTScore with as the underlying model.

answer_4.quote: Additionally to the automatic evaluation, we also perform a manual evaluation to qualitatively assess the quality of generated summaries. To this end, we take the best-performing models for each aspect excluding EtA Gold setups which require access to the gold aspect annotations, and evaluate 25 samples from the test split using three criteria as our annotation quality validation setup (described in Section 4).
answer_4.guideline: evaluation based on relevance, consistency, and fluency criteria
